headline: 6-0 win: Canada secure first ever World Cup finals victory over Qatar
summary: Jonathan David's hat-trick leads Canada to a historic first win, moving them to the top of Group B with four points.
details: Canada achieved a historic milestone by thrashing Qatar 6-0, marking their first-ever victory in the World Cup finals. The win was fueled by a hat-trick from Jonathan David and a dominant performance in front of a vocal home crowd.

The match took a dramatic turn when Qatar were reduced to nine men following two red cards. Homam Ahmed received a red after a VAR review, and Assim Madibo was sent off following a tackle that left Canada's Ismael Kone with a serious leg injury.

Cyle Larin opened the scoring in the 16th minute, followed by David's powerful volley and a close-range finish just before halftime. Nathan Saliba added a fourth via a free kick, while an own goal by Mohammad Mannai and a final strike from David completed the rout.
Despite the joy, Canada's victory was tempered by the injury to midfielder Ismael Kone, who was carried off on a stretcher and seen later with his leg in a protective boot.
Canada now move to the top of Group B with four points after two matches. They are set to face second-placed Switzerland in Vancouver on Wednesday.
Qatar, now at the bottom of the group with one point, will next face Bosnia and Herzegovina in Seattle.
caption:

Despite the joy, Canada's victory was tempered by the injury to midfielder Ismael Kone, who was carried off on a stretcher and seen later with his leg in a protective boot.

headline: 9 banks and 2 financial institutions recruit 903 Senior Officers
summary: Applications are open for permanent positions with a starting basic salary of 22,000 BDT, with a deadline of June 21.
details: Under the supervision of the Bankers Selection Committee (BSC), 9 state-owned banks and 2 financial institutions are recruiting 903 Senior Officers (General). The positions are permanent and will be filled through a competitive examination process.

The vacancies are distributed across several institutions, with Rupali Bank PLC offering 471 posts, Agrani Bank PLC 240, and Bangladesh Krishi Bank 80. Other participating institutions include Karmashangsthan Bank, Rajshahi Krishi Unnayan Bank, and various specialized financial corporations.
The basic salary scale for the position is 22,000 to 53,060 BDT, based on the 2015 National Pay Scale, along with other standard benefits and allowances.

Applicants must hold a postgraduate degree from a recognized university or a 4-year bachelor's degree. They must have first-division results in at least two public examinations and no third-division results at any stage of their academic life.
Candidates must be between 21 and 32 years old as of April 1, 2026. The selection process involves three stages: a preliminary MCQ test, a written examination, and a final viva voce.

Interested candidates can apply online via the Bangladesh Bank recruitment website (erecruitment.bb.org.bd). The application fee is 200 BDT, payable via Rocket, with a reduced fee of 50 BDT for candidates from underprivileged groups.
The deadline for online applications is June 21, 2026, at 11:59 PM. Payment verification must be completed by June 23, 2026.
